claims.text: The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (the record carries platform_policy, so the fee_schedule defaults are not reached). The platform's own waiting timer started at 12:51:19 and the driver terminated the trip at 12:52:28 — 69 seconds later, 111 seconds short of the period the fee buys. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable on an effective dwell shorter than that period, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded; the driver's stated reason for cancelling, that he had another booking waiting, is not a ground that clause recognises.

Independently of the platform's timer, the GPS-derived arrival facts measure the driver's longest continuous qualifying in-geofence run at 67 seconds, running from 12:51:17 to 12:52:24 over 8 fixes, against a STANDARD minimum dwell of 180 seconds — a shortfall of 113 seconds. POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the 'I'm Here' tap, and the derived dwell_start_offset_sec of 0.0 shows the two coincide here, so the driver cannot gain time from the marker.

POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and the rider wins by breaking a single limb. Limb (c) fails because the driver held position inside the geofence for 67 seconds, not the 180 seconds in force, and limb (d) fails because the trip was terminated at 12:52:28, before the required dwell had elapsed — limb (d) requires termination at or after the moment that dwell elapses. The reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW being one of the three codes limb (d) recognises does not save the charge where the dwell condition in limb (c) is not met.

The 113-second shortfall cannot be closed by accumulation. The derived arrival facts report run_count of 1, so there is no second in-geofence interval for POL-NS-06(i) to add to the first, and the only traffic advisory artifact on the file, EV-ADVIS-02706-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — no advisory covers the pickup road in this window, which is why limb (i) is unavailable to the driver. No shortfall can be made up out of an advisory that does not exist.

The rider's own track places the rider's device at the pickup throughout: 39 rider fixes, every one of them qualifying, stationary (0.0 kph) at 13.15 m to 19.08 m from the pickup pin, from 12:48:41 through 12:54:24 — the whole waiting window and beyond, and comfortably inside the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m. The driver's counterparty statement that the rider 'was not visible' is not supported by the platform's own telemetry of the rider's device at the pin.

POL-NS-04's other two limbs are made out. Limb (a): the rider sent a locating, coordinating message during the waiting window — 'im at the lobby, coming out', sent 12:52:17, delivered 12:52:18. Limb (b): the driver posted his only message, 'ok', at 12:52:32, four seconds AFTER he terminated the trip at 12:52:28, and the rider's message was not read until 12:52:37; nothing was posted before termination, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no in-app call was placed either. I note that POL-NS-04's closing sentence treats a reply within 120 seconds as defeating the clause, and that the rider's case does not depend on this point: the 113-second dwell shortfall under POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in any event.

On relief: the fare breakdown shows the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 actually charged (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), and the dispute is rider-filed, so FULL_REFUND returns the whole contested amount to the filing party. POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation-fee line only, and no driver compensation is payable where the shortfall stands.

claims.text: Arrival is established on admissible fixes, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) is carried and the rider's 'he never arrived' route is closed. The driver's trace carries 8 consecutive qualifying in-radius fixes running from 12:51:17 to 12:52:24, all inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius that POL-NS-02 sets for this zone class, with a closest approach of 0.11 m on a 100.0% coverage, 10-second-cadence trace with no gaps and weight 1.0.

The 'I'm Here' tap at 12:51:17 is a genuine marker, not a false marker under POL-NS-05. The derived arrival clock starts at that exact timestamp (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0) - the first qualifying in-geofence fix and the tap coincide - so the marker does not fall to be recomputed from a substituted fix, the waiting clock was correctly started at 12:51:19, and no false-arrival record falls to be entered against the driver in the ruling's referrals.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is carried: the trip record shows no boarding event and a termination by the driver at 12:52:28 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three reason codes that limb recognises, so the charge is not defeated on the reason-code ground.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. The rider's only coordinating message is MSG-02706-001, sent 12:52:17 ('im at the lobby, coming out'); the driver posted a reply at 12:52:32, 15 seconds later and inside the clause's 120-second window. The record shows that reply was sent four seconds after the termination at 12:52:28, but limb (b) measures a reply within 120 seconds of the rider's message, and the clause's closing words are that where the driver did reply within 120 seconds the clause does not apply regardless of the content of the reply. The rider's exoneration route under this clause therefore fails and the fee is decided under POL-NS-01 and its neighbours.

No anti-farming concern attaches to this driver and no POL-NS-09 escalation is available on that ground. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, which does not reach the 4-or-more count limb of the POL-NS-07 check, and 0 divided by completed_trips_30d of 107 is below the 0.08 rate limb, so the 80 percent payout would not be withheld were the fee chargeable. POL-GEN-01 confines citable profile fields to the tests that name them: the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags (2) is not the field POL-NS-07 reads and may not be substituted for the trailing-30-day figure, and no other profile field can ground an adverse finding about this trip.

The driver does not contest the one limb that fails, and does not stretch it. Measured as POL-NS-01(c) directs - from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the tap - the continuous dwell is 67 seconds against the free waiting period in force of 180 seconds carried by trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, a shortfall of 113 seconds. POL-NS-06's accumulation limb cannot be called up to bridge it: the trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), and EV-ADVIS-02706-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so no traffic advisory can be asserted to sum separate intervals. On the driver's own evidence the shortfall rule of POL-NS-06 therefore answers the cancellation-fee line, and this brief rises and falls on limbs (a), (b) and (d), which the record does carry.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02706 is refunded in full to the rider. No driver compensation is payable. The monetary effect is SGD 4.50, at or below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so the refund executes on issue.

Why the charge cannot stand. A no-show fee is chargeable only if every limb of POL-NS-01 holds, and limb (c) does not. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, EV-TRIP-02706). Measured the way POL-NS-01(c) requires — from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the arrival tap — the driver held position for 67 seconds, from 12:51:17 to 12:52:24 (longest qualifying in-geofence run, EV-GPS-02706), and the platform's own wait timer agrees, running from 12:51:19 to the 12:52:28 termination. That is a shortfall of 113 seconds. Limb (d) fails on the same arithmetic, because the termination did not fall at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed. POL-NS-06 then refunds the cancellation-fee line in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages.

The shortfall cannot be bridged. POL-NS-06(i) allows separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a qualifying traffic advisory covers the pickup road; this trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), and the only advisory artifact on file, EV-ADVIS-02706-01, is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so no accumulation is available and no advisory can be asserted for either party.

The driver's claims. (1) Arrival on admissible fixes: accepted. The trace carries 8 qualifying in-radius fixes on a complete 10-second, 100%-coverage trace, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) is met — but limb (b) alone does not make the fee chargeable. (2) The 'I'm Here' tap is a genuine marker, not a POL-NS-05 false marker: accepted; the tap coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so no false-arrival referral is entered. (3) Limb (d)'s reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW is one of the three the limb recognises: accepted, but limb (d) also requires termination at or after the elapsed dwell, which fails. (4) POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider because the driver replied 'ok' within 120 seconds: this is outcome-neutral. Even if the driver is right that his 12:52:32 reply defeats POL-NS-04, the refund flows from POL-NS-06 independently, so the point decides nothing and I do not need to resolve it. (5) No anti-farming concern: accepted, and POL-GEN-01 is respected — the citable trailing-30-day figure is 0 against 107 completed trips, the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is not substituted for it, and no other profile field is used to ground any finding about this trip. (6) The 113-second shortfall: accepted, and it is decisive.

The rider's claims. (1) 180 seconds in force, 69 seconds on the platform timer: accepted. (2) 67-second GPS-derived run, 113-second shortfall: accepted. (3) Limb (c) and limb (d) both fail: accepted. (4) No accumulation, advisory missing: accepted. (5) The rider's device sat 13.15 m to 19.08 m from the pin across the whole window: accepted as far as it goes, but it is not needed — POL-NS-06 refunds irrespective of rider presence, so the driver's counterparty statement that the rider 'was not visible' does not change the result. That statement carries no weight_multiplier and forms no part of the confidence cap. The driver's further reason, that he had another booking waiting, is not a ground POL-NS-06 recognises. (6) Relief: accepted — SGD 4.50 is the cancellation-fee line actually charged (EV-FARE-02706, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), and that is the whole of the contested amount.

Confidence is 0.95. The deciding fact — the shortfall against the 180-second waiting period — is carried by EV-GPS-02706 and EV-TRIP-02706, both at weight_multiplier 1.0, and neither is impaired under POL-NS-08. The missing advisory carries no deciding fact and does not lower the cap.

Referrals: none. No clause produces one. The arrival marker was genuine, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is not tripped; and no POL-NS-09 trigger applies (confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, the parties have no trailing-90-day dispute history, and no deciding artifact is impaired).

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

WHAT WAS CHARGED. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02706) shows a cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50, total charged SGD 4.50, payment status CHARGED, refund issued SGD 0.00. That is the amount returned. The dispute is rider-filed, so FULL_REFUND returns the whole contested sum.

WHY THE FEE DOES NOT STAND. Under POL-NS-01 a no-show fee is chargeable only if all four of its conditions hold. Three hold. (a) The trip record (EV-TRIP-02706) carries the driver's 'I'm Here' event at 12:51:17. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02706) places him 0.11 m from the pickup pin, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius POL-NS-02 sets, at that same 12:51:17 timestamp; arrival is established on admissible fixes, the marker is genuine rather than false, and the driver's second and third points are accepted, so no false-arrival entry is made against him. (d) The trip was ended by the driver at 12:52:28 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises.

CONDITION (c) FAILS, AND THAT DECIDES THE CASE. Limb (c) requires a continuous dwell inside the geofence of at least the free waiting period in force - 180 seconds, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec. Measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, as POL-NS-01(c) and POL-NS-06 require, the driver's longest continuous qualifying run is 67 seconds (12:51:17 to 12:52:24, 8 fixes); the platform's own waiting timer, from 12:51:19 to the 12:52:28 termination, is 69 seconds. On either measurement the dwell is about a minute against 180 required, a shortfall of 113 seconds on the GPS figure. Both advocates accept this - it is the one limb that fails. Limb (d) also fails on timing, because the termination preceded the moment the required dwell would have elapsed; the reason code being one the limb recognises does not save it.

EFFECT. Under POL-NS-06 an effective dwell shorter than the free waiting period makes the cancellation fee not chargeable and refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded. POL-NS-01 limb (c) is not met, so the fee cannot stand, and POL-NS-06 supplies the refund.

ACCUMULATION CANNOT CLOSE THE SHORTFALL. POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where the trace shows more than one interval and a qualifying traffic advisory is present and populated. The derived arrival facts report run_count 1, and the only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-02706-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT). There is no second interval to add and nothing to add it with.

THE RIDER'S PRESENCE. The rider's own track (EV-GPS-02706) places the rider's device 13.15 m to 19.08 m from the pin, stationary, on 39 qualifying fixes from 12:48:41 to 12:54:24, well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. The driver's counterparty statement that the rider 'was not visible' is not supported by the platform's own telemetry of the rider's device, and the driver's stated reason for cancelling - another booking waiting - is not a ground any clause in this category recognises. None of this is needed for the refund, since POL-NS-06 returns the fee whether or not the rider was present, but it is recorded.

THE RIDER'S COORDINATION POINT (POL-NS-04). The rider sent a locating message at 12:52:17 ('im at the lobby, coming out'); the driver replied 'ok' at 12:52:32 - 15 seconds later, but 4 seconds after he had already ended the trip at 12:52:28. The driver's advocate argues the reply within 120 seconds defeats the clause; the rider's advocate argues it came too late to matter.
